sources.title: Infosys leaked FullAdminAccess AWS keys on PyPI for over a year (502 points)

claims.text: The public GitHub organisation has 102 repositories and the recently active ones are digital-public-infrastructure components (esignet, inji-certify, mimoto), committed to within the last two days — real engineering, but almost none of it carries external stars or contributors.

The loudest public engineering discussion of this company remains a 2022 credential-leak thread; there is little recent first-hand engineering commentary either way, which for a 328,000-person company means the public record is close to silent.

The company describes AI adoption as a strategic risk in its own filing ('Our investments in or use of AI technologies may not be successful'), which is a more candid framing than the marketing site offers.

gaps.reason: no dated first-hand employee accounts from the last 18 months were found, so wlb_sentiment is unset; at this headcount, absence of public commentary is not evidence either way
gaps.suggested_fallback: ask to speak to two engineers on the specific delivery account, and ask what the on-call and client-hours expectations are for that account rather than for the company

eng_output_signal.note: active public repos, but narrow in scope and with negligible outside adoption for a company of this size
